The '''U-55 orbital loadlifter''', also known as the '''U-55 loadlifter''' or '''Resistance transport''' and, informally, as a '''lifeboat''', was a type of [[transport]] [[shuttle]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It was used by the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|These transport ships are unarmed, unshielded.|[[Poe Dameron]], regarding U-55 loadlifters|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
The U-55 loadlifter was designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It was used heavily by the [[Resistance]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> However, the ship lacked weaponry, [[Deflector shield|shielding]]<ref name="Episode VIII" /> or a [[hyperdrive]];<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> making it vulnerable without an escort by [[starfighter]]s or [[capital ship]]s. During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], many of the Resistance's craft were equipped with cloaking systems developed by the [[technician]] [[Rose Tico]] using a [[computer]] system to baffle their energy signals.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==History==
{{Quote|Sir, we checked on the information from the thief. We ran a decloaking scan, and sure enough, thirty Resistance transports have just launched from the cruiser.|A First Order officer|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
[[File:Final_lifeboats_are_away.png|thumb|left|250px|Resistance lifeboats evacuate D'Qar]]
The Resistance used these loadlifters to [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuate]] their [[Resistance base|base]] on [[D'Qar]],<ref name="Episode VIII" /> earning the moniker "lifeboat."<ref name="TLJVD" /> During the [[Battle of Oetchi]], these [[transport]]s were also used to evacuate the [[Starship|ships]] that ran out of [[fuel]], such as the ''[[Ninka]]'' and the [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']]. Thirty of the U-55 transports were used to evacuate the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], but only six made it to [[Crait]] after the [[First Order]] fleet opened fire on them. They were subsequently abandoned when the remaining survivors fled aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
